4_surface_interior_feature_and_miss_bins.interior_definition: No marked physical boundary face on the cell; this does not mean the cell has no boundary vertices.

5_short_edges.definition: Among cells bad in q or J, counted once if any current transported-metric edge length is below0.9 or below0.5; correlation does not prove construction causation.

6_geometry_excess_and_authority_types.authority_count_note: One bad cell may have multiple surface types; type counts can overlap and need not sum to geometry_bad.

7_distinct_global_fixed_metric_drift.target_fidelity_note: Current transported nodal target/full_target tag is not independently immutable original continuous CFD-metric certification.

geometry_service.scope: Complete quality-entry to natural EXIT passive counters, no new profiler/query campaign. Summed rank timers are nested/overlapping, not global wall time. ownership_migrations.note: Ten late census-preserved migrations are included in the interval total of 60 ownership changes (six ownership updates per migration). The migration receipt also contains startup/out-of-interval records; do not treat redistribution as repair. Cache counter deltas and per-rank debt/count conservation are retained per migration.
